jobs.title: Recruiting Operations Coordinator
responsibilities: Partner with recruiters and hiring managers
jobs.description: Responsibilities: Coordinate high-volume technical interviews and candidate communication. Maintain accurate Greenhouse ATS data, manage job requisitions, support offer letters and onboarding, partner with recruiters and hiring managers, build reporting dashboards, and improve candidate experience across a global team. Qualifications: Three years of relevant experience required.

jobs.title: People Operations Coordinator
jobs.description: Responsibilities: Own preboarding and onboarding communications, maintain employee records and data accuracy, prepare Excel reports, partner cross-functionally with managers, and improve People Operations documentation. Qualifications: Two years of related experience required.

jobs.title: Senior Rust Software Engineer
jobs.description: Responsibilities: Design distributed systems in Rust, operate Kubernetes infrastructure, review production code, and mentor engineers. Qualifications: Seven years of software engineering experience required.
